084        protected int pickDifficulty(DifficultyChoice choice) {
085                //if (true) return 6;
086                if (difficultyOverride != null) return difficultyOverride;
087                
088                AggregateBountyData d = getAggregateData();
089                
090                float total = 0f;
091                float count = 0f;
092                for (Integer diff : d.completedDifficulty) {
093                        total += diff;
094                        count++;
095                }
096                
097                float difficulty = total;
098                if (count > 0) {
099                        difficulty /= Math.max(count, NUM_TO_TRACK_FOR_DIFFICULTY);
100                        difficulty = (int) difficulty;
101                }
102                
103                int min = CustomBountyCreator.MIN_DIFFICULTY;
104                int max = CustomBountyCreator.MAX_DIFFICULTY;
105                
106                switch (choice) {
107                case LOW:
108                        min = 0;
109                        max = max - 3;
110                        difficulty = Math.min(difficulty - 3f, (int)(difficulty / 2f));
111                        break;
112                case NORMAL:
113                        min = min + 1;
114                        max = max - 1;
115                        difficulty = difficulty + 1;
116                        break;
117                case HIGH:
118                        min = 4;
119                        difficulty = difficulty + 3;
120                        break;
121                }
122                
123                int result = (int)Math.round(difficulty);
124                //result += genRandom.nextInt(2);
125                                
126                if (result < min) {
127                        result = min;
128                }
129                if (result > max) {
130                        result = max;
131                }
132                return result;
133        }
134        
135        protected CustomBountyCreator pickCreator(int difficulty, DifficultyChoice choice) {
136                //if (true) return new CBRemnantPlus();
137                //if (true) return new CBMercUW();
138                if (creatorOverride != null) {
139                        try {
140                                return (CustomBountyCreator) creatorOverride.newInstance();
141                        } catch (Throwable t) {
142                                throw new RuntimeException(t);
143                        }
144                }
145                
146                WeightedRandomPicker<CustomBountyCreator> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<CustomBountyCreator>(genRandom);
147                
148                float quality = getQuality();
149                float maxDiff = CustomBountyCreator.MAX_DIFFICULTY;
150                
151                for (CustomBountyCreator curr : getCreators()) {
152                        if (curr.getMinDifficulty() > difficulty) continue;
153                        if (curr.getMaxDifficulty() < difficulty) continue;
154                        
155                        
156                        if (choice == DifficultyChoice.HIGH) {
157                                int threshold = CBStats.getThresholdNotHigh(getClass());
158                                if (difficulty >= threshold) continue;
159                        }
160                        if (choice == DifficultyChoice.NORMAL) {
161                                int threshold = CBStats.getThresholdNotNormal(getClass());
162                                if (difficulty >= threshold) continue;
163                        }
164                        
165                        float probToSkip = (1.1f - quality) * (float) curr.getMinDifficulty() / maxDiff;
166                        if (rollProbability(probToSkip)) continue;
167                        
168                        picker.add(curr, curr.getFrequency(this, difficulty));
169                }
170                
171                return picker.pick();
172        }

188        @Override
189        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
190                //genRandom = Misc.random;
191                
192//              setTestMode(CBPirate.class, 10);
193//              setTestMode(CBPather.class, 10);
194//              setTestMode(CBDeserter.class, 10);
195//              setTestMode(CBDerelict.class, 10);
196//              setTestMode(CBMerc.class, 10);
197//              setTestMode(CBRemnant.class, 10);
198//              setTestMode(CBRemnantPlus.class, 10);
199//              setTestMode(CBRemnantStation.class, 10);
200//              setTestMode(CBTrader.class, 10);
201//              setTestMode(CBPatrol.class, 10);
202//              setTestMode(CBMercUW.class, 10);
203//              setTestMode(CBEnemyStation.class, 10);
204                
205                if (barEvent) {
206                        createBarGiver(createdAt);
207                }
208                
209                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
210                if (person == null) return false;
211                
212                String id = getMissionId();
213                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$" + id + "_ref")) {
214                        return false;
215                }
216
217                setStartingStage(Stage.BOUNTY);
218                setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
219                setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
220                addNoPenaltyFailureStages(Stage.FAILED_NO_PENALTY);
221                //setNoAbandon();
222                
223                
224                connectWithMemoryFlag(Stage.BOUNTY, Stage.COMPLETED, person, "$" + id + "_completed");
225                connectWithMemoryFlag(Stage.BOUNTY, Stage.FAILED, person, "$" + id + "_failed");
226                
227                addTag(Tags.INTEL_BOUNTY);
228                
229                
230                int dLow = pickDifficulty(DifficultyChoice.LOW);
231                creatorLow = pickCreator(dLow, DifficultyChoice.LOW);
232                //creatorLow = new CBDerelict();
233                if (creatorLow != null) {
234                        dataLow = creatorLow.createBounty(createdAt, this, dLow, Stage.BOUNTY);
235                }
236                if (dataLow == null || dataLow.fleet == null) return false;
237                
238                int dNormal = pickDifficulty(DifficultyChoice.NORMAL);
239                creatorNormal = pickCreator(dNormal, DifficultyChoice.NORMAL);
240                if (creatorNormal != null) {
241                        dataNormal = creatorNormal.createBounty(createdAt, this, dNormal, Stage.BOUNTY);
242                }
243                if (dataNormal == null || dataNormal.fleet == null) return false;
244                
245                int dHigh = pickDifficulty(DifficultyChoice.HIGH);
246                creatorHigh = pickCreator(dHigh, DifficultyChoice.HIGH);
247                if (creatorHigh != null) {
248                        dataHigh = creatorHigh.createBounty(createdAt, this, dHigh, Stage.BOUNTY);
249                }
250                //getPerson().getNameString() getPerson().getMarket();
251                if (dataHigh == null || dataHigh.fleet == null) return false;
252
253                
254                return true;
255        }

313        @Override
314        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params,
315                                                                 Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
316                
317                if ("showBountyDetail".equals(action)) {
318                        String id = getMissionId();
319                        MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
320                        DifficultyChoice difficulty = (DifficultyChoice) Enum.valueOf(DifficultyChoice.class, memory.getString("$" + id + "_difficulty"));
321                        showCreator = creatorLow;
322                        showData = dataLow;
323                        switch (difficulty) {
324                        case LOW:
325                                showCreator = creatorLow;
326                                showData = dataLow;
327                                break;
328                        case NORMAL:
329                                showCreator = creatorNormal;
330                                showData = dataNormal;
331                                break;
332                        case HIGH:
333                                showCreator = creatorHigh;
334                                showData = dataHigh;
335                                break;
336                        }
337                        
338                        setCreditRewardApplyRelMult(showData.baseReward);
339                        creditReward = Misc.getModifiedMissionReward(showData.fleet, creditReward);
340                        
341                        updateInteractionData(dialog, memoryMap);
342                        String trigger = showCreator.getId() + "OfferDesc";
343                        FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, trigger);
344                        
345                        if (showData != null && showData.system != null) {
346                                String icon = showCreator.getIconName();
347                                if (icon == null) icon = getIcon();
348                                String text = null;
349                                Set<String> tags = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
350                                tags.add(Tags.INTEL_MISSIONS);
351                                Color color = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
352                        
353                                if (showData.system.getCenter() != null && showData.system.getCenter().getMarket() != null) {
354                                        color = showData.system.getCenter().getMarket().getTextColorForFactionOrPlanet();
355                                } else if (showData.system.getCenter() instanceof PlanetAPI) {
356                                        color = Misc.setAlpha(((PlanetAPI)showData.system.getCenter()).getSpec().getIconColor(), 255);
357                                        color = Misc.setBrightness(color, 235);
358                                }
359                        
360                                dialog.getVisualPanel().showMapMarker(showData.system.getCenter(), 
361                                                        "Target: " + showData.system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort(), color, 
362                                                        true, icon, text, tags);
363                        }
364                        return true;
365                } else if ("showBountyAssessment".equals(action) && showCreator != null) {
366                        showCreator.addIntelAssessment(dialog.getTextPanel(), this, showData);
367                        return true;
368                }
369                
370
371                return super.callAction(action, ruleId, dialog, params, memoryMap);
372        }

375        @Override
376        public void accept(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
377                String id = getMissionId();
378                MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
379                DifficultyChoice difficulty = (DifficultyChoice) Enum.valueOf(DifficultyChoice.class, memory.getString("$" + id + "_difficulty"));
380                List<Abortable> abort = new ArrayList<Abortable>();
381                switch (difficulty) {
382                case LOW:
383                        creator = creatorLow;
384                        data = dataLow;
385                        abort.addAll(dataNormal.abortWhenOtherVersionAccepted);
386                        abort.addAll(dataHigh.abortWhenOtherVersionAccepted);
387                        break;
388                case NORMAL:
389                        creator = creatorNormal;
390                        data = dataNormal;
391                        abort.addAll(dataLow.abortWhenOtherVersionAccepted);
392                        abort.addAll(dataHigh.abortWhenOtherVersionAccepted);
393                        break;
394                case HIGH:
395                        creator = creatorHigh;
396                        data = dataHigh;
397                        abort.addAll(dataLow.abortWhenOtherVersionAccepted);
398                        abort.addAll(dataNormal.abortWhenOtherVersionAccepted);
399                        break;
400                }
401                
402                for (Abortable curr : abort) {
403                        curr.abort(this, false);
404                }
405                
406                creatorLow = creatorNormal = creatorHigh = null;
407                dataLow = dataNormal = dataHigh = null;
408                
409                MarketAPI createdAt = getPerson().getMarket();
410                if (createdAt == null) createdAt = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMarket();
411                if (creator.getIconName() != null) {
412                        setIconName(creator.getIconName());
413                }
414                creator.notifyAccepted(createdAt, this, data);
415                
416                target = data.fleet.getCommander();
417                data.fleet.addEventListener(this);
418                makeImportant(data.fleet, "$" + id + "_target", Stage.BOUNTY);
419
420                if (data.fleet.isHidden()) {
421                        MarketAPI market = Misc.getStationMarket(data.fleet);
422                        if (market != null) {
423                                SectorEntityToken station = Misc.getStationEntity(market, data.fleet);
424                                if (station != null) {
425                                        makeImportant(station, "$" + id + "_target", Stage.BOUNTY);
426                                }
427                        }
428                }
429                
430                if (!data.fleet.getFaction().isNeutralFaction()) {
431                        addTag(data.fleet.getFaction().getId());
432                }
433                
434                if (creator.getBountyDays() > 0) {
435                        setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, creator.getBountyDays(), creator.getSystemWithNoTimeLimit(data));
436                }
437                //setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, 3, creator.getSystemWithNoTimeLimit(data));
438                setCreditRewardApplyRelMult(data.baseReward);
439                creditReward = Misc.getModifiedMissionReward(data.fleet, creditReward);
440                
441                setRepRewardPerson(data.repPerson);
442                setRepRewardFaction(data.repFaction);
443                
444                super.accept(dialog, memoryMap);
445        }

493        @Override
494        protected void endSuccessImpl(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
495                creator.notifyCompleted(this, data);
496                
497                AggregateBountyData d = getAggregateData();
498                d.completedDifficulty.add(data.difficulty);
499                while (d.completedDifficulty.size() > NUM_TO_TRACK_FOR_DIFFICULTY) {
500                        d.completedDifficulty.remove(0);
501                }
502        }
503        
504        @Override
505        protected void endFailureImpl(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
506                creator.notifyFailed(this, data);
507                
508                AggregateBountyData d = getAggregateData();
509                d.completedDifficulty.add(0);
510                while (d.completedDifficulty.size() > NUM_TO_TRACK_FOR_DIFFICULTY) {
511                        d.completedDifficulty.remove(0);
512                }
513                
514        }
515        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
516                if (isDone() || result != null) return;
517                
518                // also credit the player if they're in the same location as the fleet and nearby
519                float distToPlayer = Misc.getDistance(fleet, Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet());
520                boolean playerInvolved = battle.isPlayerInvolved() || (fleet.isInCurrentLocation() && distToPlayer < 2000f);
521                
522                if (battle.isInvolved(fleet) && !playerInvolved) {
523                        boolean cancelBounty = (fleet.isStationMode() && fleet.getFlagship() == null) ||
524                                        (!fleet.isStationMode() && fleet.getFlagship() != null && fleet.getFlagship().getCaptain() != target);
525                        if (cancelBounty) {
526                                String id = getMissionId();
527                                getPerson().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$" + id + "_failed", true);
528                                return;
529                        }
530//                      if (fleet.getFlagship() == null || fleet.getFlagship().getCaptain() != target) {
531//                              fleet.setCommander(fleet.getFaction().createRandomPerson());
532//                              //latestResult = new BountyResult(BountyResultType.END_OTHER, 0, null);
533//                              sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, true);
534//                              return;
535//                      }
536                }
537                
538                //CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
539                if (!playerInvolved || !battle.isInvolved(fleet) || battle.onPlayerSide(fleet)) {
540                        return;
541                }
542                
543                if (fleet.isStationMode()) {
544                        if (fleet.getFlagship() != null) return;
545                } else {
546                        if (fleet.getFlagship() != null && fleet.getFlagship().getCaptain() == target) return;
547                }
548                
549                String id = getMissionId();
550                getPerson().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$" + id + "_completed", true);
551                
552        }
